sections.description: Theme-independent WPForms recipe link delivery with optional consent-based Kit or Flodesk signup.
sections.changelog:
= 1.3.1 =
* Display the official Made to Thrive circle badge in WordPress plugin updates.
= 1.3.0 =
* Add optional Kit and Flodesk integrations, provider selection, safe connection checks and preserved Flodesk upgrade settings.


= 1.2.4 =
* Use the plugin name without an MTT prefix; retain Made to Thrive authorship and the handwritten mtt icon.
= 1.2.3 =
* Replace the pixel field with Small, Medium and Large logo presets; default to Medium.

= 1.2.2 =
* Edit footer text inline in the email preview.

= 1.2.1 =
* Link the logo, hide duplicate site text, and place the heading before the greeting.

= 1.2.0 =
* Use native media and color pickers with a responsive branding sidebar and live preview.
* Hide shared branding controls unless the provider is available.

= 1.1.0 =
* Add standalone branding and sender controls with optional shared branding.

= 1.0.1 =
* Show an actionable form error when email delivery fails or is rate limited.
* Prevent success redirects and newsletter requests after failed delivery.
* Require the newsletter consent mapping to point to a checkbox field.

= 1.0.0 =
* Extract reusable recipe delivery from the Bake With Zoha implementation.
* Add MTT update-channel support and independent settings.
* Keep other newsletter forms under their existing provider settings.
* Reject password-protected posts and invalid recipe requests before subscription.
